name: BODY_OD
note: Nominal 66 mm-class spiral kraft/phenolic body tube. MEASURE the purchased tube and update.

name: BODY_ID
note: Measure purchased tube (3 places, 2 axes). Drives every shoulder, ring and bulkhead fit.

name: CPL_OD
note: Matching commercial coupler. Must slip-fit BODY_ID (0.1-0.4 mm diametral clearance).

name: CPL_ID
note: Measure purchased coupler.

name: TUBE_RHO
note: Effective density of paper/phenolic tube. Verify by weighing a known length.

name: FIT_SH
note: Diametral clearance, printed shoulder / ring in tube. Tune with a printed test coupon first.

name: NC_L
note: Exposed nose length, tangent ogive, fineness 4.0 (NC_L / BODY_OD).

name: NC_WALL
note: Printed ogive wall = 3 perimeters x 0.4 mm nozzle.

name: NC_SH_L
note: Shoulder length ~0.9 calibre.

name: NC_SH_WALL
note: Shoulder wall (4 perimeters); hosts radial heat-set inserts.

name: NC_SPLIT
note: Print split station so each half fits a 250 mm Z-height printer.

name: NC_BH_T
note: Printed nose bulkhead / ballast mount thickness.

name: BALLAST_ROD_L
note: M6 A2 threaded rod length forward of NC-103 (rod is cut to BALLAST_ROD_L + NC_BH_T = 86).

name: NC_TIP_SOLID
note: Solid printed tip before the internal cavity starts (CAD rev B).

name: NC_SPIGOT_L
note: NC-101 spigot length aft of the print split (engages NC-102 socket).

name: NC_SPLIT_WEB
note: Solid annular web closing NC-101 at the split; the spigot grows from it (CAD rev B, printable).

name: NC_SPIGOT_WALL
note: Spigot wall thickness.

name: FIT_SOCKET
note: Diametral clearance spigot-to-socket (I-00, slip fit +0.1/+0.3).

name: NC_BASE_RING
note: Closing ring between ogive wall and shoulder at the nose base.

name: NC_BOSS_T
note: Radial insert boss depth inside the shoulder (wall + boss = 6.0 >= insert + 0.5).

name: NC_LUG_L
note: NC-103 mounting lug length (lugs end at the bulkhead forward face, CAD rev B).

name: NC_LUG_T
note: NC-103 mounting lug radial depth.

name: NC_SCREW_ANG
note: Angular positions of the 3 radial nose screws (I-01).

name: NC_LUG_ANG
note: Angular positions of the 3 NC-103 lugs.

name: PL_L
note: Payload tube length. Clear payload bay = PL_L - NC_SH_L - AV insertion - bulkheads.

name: CAM_LENS_HOLE
note: Set from the chosen camera's lens barrel diameter + 1 mm.

name: CAM_MASS
note: Weigh the chosen camera (with its cable). 35 g is a planning placeholder.

name: CAM_OFF
note: Camera lens-hole station aft of the nose shoulder end (STA 360).

name: CAM_ANG
note: Camera / lens-cowl angular position.

name: CAM_TILT
note: Lens axis tilted aft from radial (matches the PL-204 window).

name: CAM_W
note: Camera body width (PLACEHOLDER: measure your camera). Rev B: 29 -> 26; the rev A 29 x 16 x 45 placeholder interfered with the tube wall at 15 deg tilt.

name: CAM_H
note: Camera body depth along the lens axis (PLACEHOLDER; rev A 16).

name: CAM_LEN
note: Camera body length (PLACEHOLDER; rev A 45). The CAD re-seats any size inside the bore; the pipeline then checks tray clearance.

name: CAM_LENS_L
note: Lens barrel protrusion from the camera face (PLACEHOLDER).

name: HATCH_OFF
note: Hatch centre station aft of the nose shoulder end (STA 395).

name: HATCH_ANG
note: Hatch angular position (over the GPS).

name: HATCH_W
note: Hatch cut-out chord width.

name: HATCH_L
note: Hatch cut-out axial length.

name: HATCH_GAP
note: Edge gap between hatch panel and cut-out.

name: HATCH_SCREW_OFF
note: Hatch screws at hatch centre +/- this (on the frame ledges).

name: FRAME_L
note: PL-206 doubler frame axial length.

name: FRAME_W
note: PL-206 doubler frame chord width.

name: FRAME_T
note: PL-206 frame thickness (bosses 4.5).

name: TRAY_L
note: PL-202 overall length including the foot.

name: TRAY_W
note: PL-202 plate width.

name: TRAY_T
note: PL-202 plate thickness.

name: TRAY_FOOT_T
note: PL-202 foot thickness (bears on AV-303).

name: TRAY_HOLE_X
note: Tray screw holes at x = +/- this (CAD rev B: clears tee-nut flanges).

name: TRAY_HOLE_Y
note: Tray screw holes at y = this (below the sled plane).

name: AV_CPL_L
note: Coupler length = 70 insertion + 30 switch band + 70 insertion.

name: AV_INS
note: Coupler insertion each side (~1.1 calibre; >= 1 calibre is the usual rule of thumb).

name: AV_BAND_L
note: Switch band length (exposed airframe ring).

name: AV_BH_T
note: Each bulkhead disc thickness (birch ply); 2 discs per bulkhead.

name: AV_ROD_SP
note: Threaded-rod spacing (M4) in the sled plane.

name: SLED_L
note: Electronics sled length.

name: SLED_W
note: Electronics sled width (fits CPL_ID with rod sleeves).

name: SLED_T
note: Sled thickness (PETG, 100% infill between rod sleeves).

name: SLED_FWD_GAP
note: Gap AV-303 to sled = forward AV-312 spacer length.

name: GASKET_T
note: AV-309 face gasket compressed thickness (1.5 mm foam free). CAD rev B: moves AV-304 outer disc aft by this.

name: SW_ANG
note: Arming-switch access angle.

name: SW_HOLE_D
note: Switch access hole through AV-302 + AV-301.

name: SW_TOWER_H
note: Switch tower height above sled; set so the switch actuator sits ~1 mm below CPL_ID.

name: STATIC_PORT_D
note: 4 static ports at 45/135/225/315 deg (size per sensor maker guidance).

name: HARNESS_D
note: Harness hole through AV-303 (grommet).

name: HARNESS_Y
note: Harness hole centre offset toward the switch side (+Y).

name: BAT_L
note: Battery length (PLACEHOLDER: set from purchased cell).

name: BAT_W
note: Battery width (PLACEHOLDER; max 28.8 to clear the rod sleeves).

name: BAT_H
note: Battery thickness (PLACEHOLDER).

name: ROD_L
note: AV-305 M4 rod length (fwd bulkhead face to 1.7 mm past the aft nut).

name: BO_L
note: Booster tube length (recovery bay + fin can).

name: MMT_OD
note: 29 mm-class motor mount tube OD. Measure purchased tube.

name: MMT_ID
note: PLACEHOLDER ONLY (MMT bore for the motor casing). Replace via simulation/motor_config.json with the selected certified product's published data.

name: MMT_L
note: PLACEHOLDER ONLY (MMT length >= longest motor + retainer requirement). Replace via simulation/motor_config.json with the selected certified product's published data.

name: MMT_AFT_EXT
note: PLACEHOLDER ONLY (MMT protrusion aft of airframe for the retainer). Replace via simulation/motor_config.json with the selected certified product's published data.

name: CR_T
note: Forward centering ring thickness (birch ply, recovery-load anchor ring).

name: CORE_RING_T
note: Fin-can core ring thickness (ASA print).

name: CORE_RAIL_T
note: Fin guide rail thickness.

name: LOCK_T
note: Aft fin lock ring thickness (birch ply: heat tolerant near motor).

name: RET_CLEAR_D
note: Lock-ring bore = retainer body OD + 1 mm. PLACEHOLDER ONLY (retainer body OD). Replace via simulation/motor_config.json with the selected certified product's published data.

name: FIN_N
note: Fin count. 4 fins -> symmetric layout for rail buttons, camera and slide-in guides.

name: FIN_CR
note: Root chord (exposed).

name: FIN_CT
note: Tip chord.

name: FIN_S
note: Semi-span (exposed, from body surface). Selected by trade study for 2-3 cal margin.

name: FIN_XR
note: Leading-edge sweep length (root LE to tip LE, parallel to axis). Tip TE stays 20 mm forward of the tail.

name: FIN_T
note: Fin thickness: 3 mm aircraft birch ply (baseline) or 3.2 mm G10 (upgrade, heavier).

name: FIN_TAB_FWD
note: Tab starts this far aft of root LE.

name: FIN_SLOT_CLR
note: Tube slot width = FIN_T + FIN_SLOT_CLR.

name: FIN_GUIDE_CLR
note: Printed guide slot width = FIN_T + FIN_GUIDE_CLR.

name: FIN_TAB_CLR
note: Radial clearance between fin tab root and the BO-403 tab floor.

name: LOCK_SCREW_R
note: Pitch radius of the 4 lock-ring screws (45/135/225/315 deg).

name: RB_FWD_OFF
note: Forward rail button this far forward of the MMT forward end (on BO-409).

name: RB_AFT_OFF
note: Aft rail button this far forward of the tail (on BO-403 boss).

name: RB_ANG
note: Rail-button line, midway between fins 1 and 2.

name: KEVLAR_NOTCH_ANG
note: Aramid leader notch in BO-404 (opposite the rail line).

name: INS_M3_D
note: Hole for M3 brass heat-set insert (use the insert maker's value).

name: INS_M3_L
note: M3 insert length (insert maker).

name: INS_M25_D
note: Hole for M2.5 heat-set insert (insert maker).

name: INS_M25_L
note: M2.5 insert length (insert maker).

name: INS_M4_D
note: Hole for M4 heat-set insert in printed bosses (insert maker).

name: INS_M4_L
note: M4 insert length (insert maker).

name: CLR_M25
note: ISO 273 medium clearance hole, M2.5.

name: CLR_M3
note: ISO 273 medium clearance hole, M3.

name: CLR_M4
note: ISO 273 medium clearance hole, M4.

name: CLR_M6
note: Close clearance for the M6 eyebolt / ballast rod.

name: TNUT_BARREL_D
note: M4 tee-nut barrel hole (confirm with purchased tee-nut).

name: TNUT_FLANGE_D
note: M4 tee-nut flange diameter (confirm; used for clearance checks).

name: TNUT_FLANGE_T
note: M4 tee-nut flange thickness (confirm).

name: NUT_M4_H
note: DIN 985 M4 nylock nut height (verify against purchased part).

name: WASHER_M4_T
note: ISO 7089 M4 washer thickness.

name: SHCS_M3_DK
note: ISO 4762 M3 socket-head diameter (tool-access checks).

name: RB_ENV_D
note: Rail-button ENVELOPE placeholder diameter; real size from button maker.

name: RB_ENV_H
note: Rail-button ENVELOPE placeholder standoff; real size from button maker.

name: EYE_ENV_D
note: M6 eyebolt ENVELOPE placeholder (eye OD); from eyebolt maker.

name: EYE_ENV_L
note: M6 eyebolt ENVELOPE placeholder length aft of AV-304.

name: RET_ENV_L
note: PLACEHOLDER ONLY (retainer length aft of airframe). Replace via simulation/motor_config.json with the selected certified product's published data.

name: FN
note: OpenSCAD facets per full circle (CAD resolution only).

name: PETG_RHO
note: Typical PETG filament density (check spool datasheet).

name: ASA_RHO
note: Typical ASA filament density (check spool datasheet).

name: PLY_RHO
note: Aircraft birch plywood, typical. Weigh your sheet.

name: STEEL_RHO
note: Stainless steel A2.

name: MOTOR_L
note: PLACEHOLDER ONLY (motor length). Replace via simulation/motor_config.json with the selected certified product's published data.

name: MOTOR_M0
note: PLACEHOLDER ONLY (loaded motor mass). Replace via simulation/motor_config.json with the selected certified product's published data.

name: MOTOR_MB
note: PLACEHOLDER ONLY (burnout motor mass). Replace via simulation/motor_config.json with the selected certified product's published data.

name: RET_MASS
note: PLACEHOLDER ONLY (retainer mass). Replace via simulation/motor_config.json with the selected certified product's published data.

name: V_DESC
note: Target descent rate under main parachute.

name: CHUTE_D
note: Selected nominal parachute diameter (42 in class) from the descent-rate calculation.

name: CHUTE_CD
note: Parachute drag coefficient on nominal area. Replace with the chute manufacturer's figure if published.

name: RHO_AIR
note: ISA sea level. Use site altitude/temperature in the simulator (USER).

name: SHOCK_K
note: Opening-shock amplification over steady drag (conservative planning value).

name: N_AX
note: Design axial load factor. REPLACE with 1.5 x simulated peak acceleration of the chosen motor.

name: V_MAX
note: Design velocity limit for this airframe (printed nose, kraft tubes, ply fins).

name: ALPHA_GUST
note: Angle of attack for fin side-load check (rail exit in cross-wind).

name: TAU_BOND
note: Allowable shear on epoxy-to-paper tube bonds (paper delamination governs; very conservative).

name: PLY_SIG
note: Allowable bending stress, birch ply (conservative vs typical published values).

name: PLY_G
note: In-plane shear modulus, 3 mm birch ply (for flutter screening only).

name: TUBE_E
note: Axial modulus of kraft/phenolic tube (vibration order-of-magnitude only).

name: A2_70_PROOF
note: ISO 3506-1 property class A2-70 minimum 0.2% proof stress.

name: M4_AS
note: ISO 898 / ISO 724 tensile stress area, M4 coarse.

name: RAIL
note: Launch rail profile offered by YOUR range. Rail buttons must match it.

name: RAIL_L
note: Usable rail length at YOUR range (planning value 1.0 m).
